articles.title: Referrer-Policy: no-referrer を付けたら、Next.jsのServer Actionsが500になった
articles.accessNote: Full public original article body. Measurements are author-reported. No source code or commands executed.
articles.facts: Observed null Origin and host mismatch on Next.js 16.3.8/Vercel. strict-origin restored the tested Chrome login. CORS fetch and non-CORS submissions differ. Actual failing transport and difference between browser environments were not isolated.

articles.title: BigQuery の TabFM と LightGBM を Diamonds で比較
articles.accessNote: Full public original article body. Measurements are author-reported. No source code or commands executed.
articles.facts: Diamonds nine features, log price transformed back, five seeds, median absolute relative error. At 10,000 rows 4.80% versus 4.97%. At 20,000 rows TabFM ran in one of five seeds with 500-row batches. High-carat split at 1.51 differs from ordinary split. Cost not measured.
